title: Calibrated Pressure-Observable Born and Hessian Actions for Quantum-Assisted Waveform Inversion
summary: We construct a pressure-consistent operator-and-readout interface for Born, adjoint, and Gauss--Newton actions in constant-density acoustic full-waveform inversion (FWI) using Schrödingerised propagation. The energy variables $π=c^{-1}\partial_t u$ and $q=\nabla u$ yield an auxiliary-space Hamiltonian, while physical pressure $p=cπ$ depends explicitly on wavespeed. Its derivative $D(cπ)[c_0](δc)=c_0δπ+δc\,π_0$ combines propagated wavefield sensitivity with a direct receiver-calibration term.
